system.description:
By means of this spell, the magic-user may gain knowledge of one item, place, or person. If the caster holds the item being studied, the spell takes [[/r 1d4 #Turns]] turns to complete, and the magic-user learns the item's name, method of operation and command words (if any), and approximate number of charges (if any, within five of the correct number).

If the item has more than one mode of operation, or more than one command word, only one function will be revealed for each lore spell used, and the spell will not even hint that the object has any other functions.

If the spell is being used to investigate a place or person, or an item which the caster is not holding, the spell may take [[/r 1d100 #Days]] days to complete. A purely legendary topic should require large amounts of time, and the information gained may be in the form of a riddle or poem. The Dungeon Master should reveal only general details if the place is large, or if the person is of great power.
system.effect: Reveals details of 1 item, place, or person
